intro.text: A conveyor that reads the barcodes on every PCB on the line and sends the data straight to your MES, so each board is traced without manual scanning.

items: Reads 1D and 2D codes (EAN, UPC, Code39, ITF25, Codabar, Code93, Code128)
Reads top and bottom sides at the same time, for both panel types
Alarms for missing, wrong, mixed or duplicate codes
Programming in under 10 seconds; changeover by recalling the saved program
Servo drive with lead screw or high-tension belt
Sends barcode data directly to MES
Standard SMEMA interface for inline connection with other equipment
